description: Search businesses in the Spotby registry with natural-language terms (what they do, services, needs) and/or a location. Results are ranked: any term can match, businesses covering more terms come first. Location matches the business address and also the areas the owner says they serve. Each result includes provenance (asserted_by: owner-maintained or imported from open data) and why it matched. Use get_business for full details.

category.description: Optional. Exact filter only for Spotby keys: ristorazione (food and drink), negozio (shop), servizi (personal services), professionisti (professional services), artigiani (trades and crafts), ricettivita (accommodation). Any other value is treated as an extra search term.

industry.description: Optional boost by industry the business serves (B2B): fashion, retail, food, hospitality, finance, healthcare, manufacturing, tech, realestate, services, nonprofit, public

location.description: City, town or area, e.g. "Newcastle". Matches where the business is located or the areas it serves.

query.description: Natural-language terms, any language (English or Italian work best), e.g. "24/7 emergency plumber blocked drains" or "gluten free trattoria"

name: search_businesses
